name: Burleigh County, ND
findings: Burleigh County has 496 nonprofit organizations. 257 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 213 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Burleigh County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
